overview: This paper proposes a meta-learning approach for post-training quantization of diffusion models that jointly optimizes calibration sample weights and frequency component weights at each denoising timestep, using bi-level optimization with DWT-based frequency decomposition and a regularization term encouraging the quantized model to follow the full-precision model's frequency evolution pattern (low-frequency recovery in early stages, high-frequency in later stages).

modules.name: Configuration Management Module
modules.description: Manages all experiment configurations including dataset paths, model architectures, quantization bit-widths (W4A32, W4A8, W8A8), hyperparameters (γ, β, ηQ, ηα, ηλ, Nf, Ns, NQ), denoising timestep settings, and sampler configurations. Supports YAML/JSON parsing and experiment configuration inheritance for reproducible experiments across CIFAR-10, LSUN-Bedrooms, FFHQ, and ImageNet datasets.

modules.name: Calibration and Validation Data Generation Module
modules.description: Generates calibration dataset Sc and validation dataset Sv from the full-precision diffusion model following Q-Diffusion's approach: selecting generated images at fixed step intervals across all denoising timesteps. Each calibration sample is a tuple (xi, ti). Also supports constructing validation sets from real images by adding Gaussian noise following the forward diffusion process. Manages the temporal pairing of samples with their corresponding timesteps.

modules.name: DWT Frequency Decomposition Module
modules.description: Implements Discrete Wavelet Transform using Haar wavelet to decompose tensors into four frequency subbands: low-frequency component (a_ll) reflecting basic object structure, and three high-frequency components (a_lh, a_hl, a_hh) capturing texture details. Provides forward decomposition and the corresponding inverse transform. Serves as the foundation for frequency-weighted loss computation throughout the framework.

modules.name: Quantization Infrastructure Module
modules.description: Implements the core quantization utilities: LAPQ-based initialization of the quantized model from the full-precision counterpart, AdaRound-based weight quantization with learnable rounding, EMA-based activation range estimation for activation quantization, and block-wise reconstruction support. Handles separate quantization pipelines for weights (first) and activations (second), managing quantizer parameter storage and clipping range computation.

modules.name: Loss Functions Module
modules.description: Implements all loss functions defined in the paper: (1) LQ - output reconstruction loss between the l-th block outputs of full-precision and quantized models; (2) Lf - weighted frequency difference loss using DWT-decomposed subbands with a frequency weight vector; (3) LF - frequency loss combining Lf for noise estimator outputs; (4) Lval - validation loss combining reconstruction loss between full model outputs and the regularization term; (5) LReg - regularization loss on frequency weights encouraging low-frequency weight decrease and high-frequency weight increase as timestep decreases; (6) LFINAL - combined weighted loss for final quantization optimization.

modules.name: Sample Weight Optimization Module
modules.description: Implements the meta-learning mechanism for optimizing calibration sample weights ω = {ω_i}. For each calibration sample (xi, ti), learns a weight representing its contribution to quantized model performance. Updates sample weights by computing gradients of the validation loss Lval with respect to ω through the quantized model θ̂_Q(ω), using the higher library for implicit differentiation. Employs Adam optimizer with configurable learning rate ηα.

modules.name: Frequency Weight Optimization Module
modules.description: Implements the meta-learning mechanism for optimizing the frequency weight matrix λ of size T×4, where each row λ_ti = {λ_ti,0, λ_ti,1, λ_ti,2, λ_ti,3} corresponds to the four DWT subband weights at timestep ti. Enforces the constraint that frequency weights sum to 1 at each timestep. Updates frequency weights by computing gradients of the validation loss Lval (including the regularization term LReg with coefficient β) with respect to λ through θ̂_Q(λ). Employs Adam optimizer with configurable learning rate ηλ.

modules.name: Bi-level Optimization Controller
modules.description: Orchestrates the alternating bi-level optimization process. At each iteration for a given block: (1) fixes sample weights ω and updates frequency weights λ for Nf iterations; (2) fixes frequency weights λ and updates sample weights ω for Ns iterations. The inner optimization approximates θ̂_Q using a single gradient step. Manages the alternating update schedule and convergence checking, coordinating between the sample weight and frequency weight optimization modules.

modules.name: Block-wise Quantization Pipeline Module
modules.description: Manages the sequential quantization of model blocks/layers. For each block l: (1) initializes sample weights uniformly and frequency weight matrix; (2) runs the bi-level optimization controller to learn optimal ω and λ; (3) performs final quantization of the block by minimizing LFINAL over the calibration set using the learned weights. Handles the layer-by-layer processing of the noise estimation network architecture (DDPM or LDM) with NQ iterations per block.

modules.name: Diffusion Model Wrapper Module
modules.description: Wraps the full-precision and quantized diffusion models (DDPM and LDM architectures), providing interfaces for: extracting intermediate block outputs ϵ_FP^(l) and ϵ_Q^(l), obtaining final model outputs ϵ_FP and ϵ_Q, and running the denoising process with DDIM sampler. Manages model forward passes for both unconditional (CIFAR-10, LSUN-Bedrooms, FFHQ) and class-conditional (ImageNet) generation settings with appropriate timestep configurations.

modules.name: Evaluation Metrics Module
modules.description: Computes FID (Fréchet Inception Distance) and sFID (spatial FID) metrics using the torch-fidelity library. FID quantifies the difference between Inception image features of synthetic and real images, while sFID uses mid-level Inception features for spatial distribution similarity. Supports evaluation with 50,000 generated samples, consistent with previous work settings. Includes precomputed statistics for all benchmark datasets.

modules.name: Visualization and Analysis Module
modules.description: Provides visualization of: (1) learned frequency weight vectors λ across denoising timesteps showing the evolution of low-frequency vs. high-frequency component weights; (2) learned sample weights ω as box plots across timesteps showing weight distribution and outliers; (3) generated image comparisons between full-precision, Q-Diffusion, TFMQ-DM, and the proposed method; (4) calibration dataset visualization at early, middle, and late denoising stages showing frequency evolution.

modules.name: Ablation and Sensitivity Analysis Framework
modules.description: Implements controlled ablation experiments to evaluate: (1) individual contribution of sample weighting alone; (2) individual contribution of frequency weighting alone; (3) combined effect of both weighting mechanisms; (4) impact of regularization term LReg; (5) sensitivity analysis for hyperparameters γ and β across multiple values; (6) comparison of DWT vs. FFT frequency transformation methods; (7) comparison of generated vs. real image validation sets; (8) comparison of intermediate output frequency loss vs. approximated final sample frequency loss. Produces structured result tables.

modules.name: Experiment Runner and Reporting Module
modules.description: Orchestrates the complete experimental pipeline: running all dataset and bit-width configurations (CIFAR-10 with DDPM, LSUN-Bedrooms/FFHQ/ImageNet with LDM-4), comparing against baseline methods (PTQ4DM, Q-Diffusion, PTQD, TFMQ-DM, APQ-DM, TCAQ-DM), managing GPU resource allocation, logging training progress, saving and loading checkpoints, and generating automated LaTeX result tables and performance comparison charts for the paper.
